DPR-VIEW-01 · implementation and verification

Read-only Equipment Log · not published

Evidence boundary: Before/after browser captures mount the actual SiteReport and DprDetails components against the same mockup-derived DPR409 fixture. They are not authenticated live DPR409 screenshots. No production writes or authentication bypass were used. The app-preview browser reached the unauthenticated access boundary only.

Delivered

One shared compact renderer, consumption in L/hr or km/L, canonical-first measured/issued fallback, norm deviation flags, conditional BOQ/General/Not linked work labels, saved Task and labour Hours, complete expandable audit details, phone cards, expanded print audit, totals and one legend. Existing SiteReport Lifecycle and Send onward behavior is retained. Entry screens, operational calculations, backend, schema and Equipment Performance are unchanged.
